fields.description: Issue of Miami Life dated May 18, 1935 (Vol. 9, No. 35). Prominently features a lengthy exposé/attack on N. Vernon Hawthorne, describing alleged misconduct as state’s attorney, political manipulation, and protection of certain suspects and officials, with references to grand jury actions and state politics. Includes local election commentary and civic editorials, columns on sports and horse racing tips ("Jockey Jimmy"), community notes and rumors, and extensive local advertising.
